description: Citizen Lab content-category legend: maps every category code used across the censorship data (NEWS, POLR, HUMR, ANON, GMB, LGBT, REL, ...) to its human name plus how many domains carry it in the corpus, how many are confirmed blocked nationally somewhere, and how many countries block that category. The reference for interpreting any category code returned by get_category_leaders, get_censorship_intent, or the national blocklist. HONEST: national counts are over the >=3-network confirmed layer (a floor); China under-counted (GFW=anomaly).
name: get_categories
